description: The bar chart illustrates the average number of likes (“Avg. Like #”) associated with posts grouped by the “Most similar group of posts,” shown as five angular-interval categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450], displayed left to right in that order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Avg. Like #” on a linear scale with visible tick labels from 400 up to 600 at regular 50-unit intervals (400, 450, 500, 550, 600). Each category is represented by a single light-blue bar with a thin dark outline and a vertical error bar (black line with caps) indicating variability/uncertainty; the approximate bar heights are about 600 for (0,90], about 567 for (90,180], about 572 for (180,270], about 595 for (270,360], and about 590 for (360,450]. The error bars appear shortest for (0,90] and longer for the later intervals, with the largest error ranges visually on (270,360] and (360,450]. The bars are not shown as stacked or grouped beyond the single series, there is no legend, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the uniform styling.
